description: This file defines the internal implementation of asynchronous enumerable support for Orleans grains. It provides mechanisms for starting, moving, and disposing of async enumerators, managing enumerator state, cleanup, and diagnostic logging.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerableGrainExtension
classes.description: Provides support for returning IAsyncEnumerable from grain methods, managing enumerator lifecycle, cleanup, and coordination with timers and logging.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of all enumerators and the internal timer, releasing resources.

methods.name: RemoveExpiredAsync
methods.description: Removes enumerators that have expired based on internal flags, invoking cleanup asynchronously.

methods.name: StartEnumeration
methods.description: Initiates a new asynchronous enumeration, setting up the enumerator and tracking state.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the enumerator for a given request ID, returning the current value or error if missing or invalid.

methods.name: MoveNextCore
methods.description: Core logic for moving the enumerator forward, handling synchronous and asynchronous cases.

methods.name: AwaitMoveNextAsync
methods.description: Awaiter for MoveNextAsync, with timeout and error handling.

methods.name: RemoveEnumeratorAsync
methods.description: Removes and disposes of a specific enumerator by request ID.

methods.name: OnTerminateAsync
methods.description: Performs cleanup after enumeration completes or errors occur.

methods.name: DisposeEnumeratorAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the enumerator, cancelling tasks and releasing resources.

methods.name: OnEnumeratorCleanupCompleted
methods.description: Logs cleanup completion event for diagnostics.

inner_structs.name: EnumeratorState
inner_structs.description: Tracks the state of an active enumerator, including flags, the enumerator object, move-next task, batch size, and cancellation token source.
